name: gemm_a8w8_blockwise_scaled_b_shuffled_row_major_a_scale_n1024_k4096
description: fp8 gemm dequantized per block: a fp32 scale per 128 x 128 of b, per 1 x 128 of a, K-major or MN-major. operand_format is '<a>:<b>'; 'none:preshuffled' is aiter's 16 x 16 shuffle_weight b with a raw column-major a_scale. Set a_scale.is_row_major to pass a row-major a_scale with a shuffled b.

sources.content:
"""FlyDSL port of `gemm_a8w8_blockwise_scaled_blk128x128_nt_obfloat16_bshuf16x16_aslogical_n1024_k4096`.

out[m, n] = sum_kb  S_a[m, kb] * S_b[n // 128, kb] * sum_{k in kb} A[m, k] * W[n, k]

* A: [M, K] fp8 e4m3fn row-major.
* B: [N, K] fp8 payload in AITER shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16)) order.
* a_scale: logical row-major [M, K/128], S_a[m, kb] = a_scale_flat[m * SK + kb].
* b_scale: [N/128, K/128] fp32 row-major.

Kernel structure (layout API, gfx950): one 128-deep K tile per pipeline stage,
one MFMA 16x16x128 f8 per (m16, n16) sub-tile into a per-tile fp32 partial,
then acc = fma(partial, S_a * S_b, acc).  A goes through a 4-stage swizzled
LDS ring (one barrier per two k-tiles), B is loaded straight from global into registers (the
preshuffle layout matches the MFMA operand lane layout) two k-tiles
ahead through four register slots; with two groups per WG (m >= 256), A is
loaded straight into its LDS stage four k-tiles ahead (async LDS DMA, one
barrier per k-tile), otherwise A global loads lead their LDS write by
two k-tiles, and the A fragment of k-tile t+1 is read from LDS into
registers during step t (interleaved with its MFMAs), so each step's MFMAs
never wait on an LDS read.  The MFMA is issued
with B as src0 and A as src1, computing C^T, so each lane owns one output row
and 4 consecutive columns: one a-scale per 16-row block instead of four, and
packed 8-byte (bf16) / 16-byte (fp32 split-K plane) stores.  The scale
products S_a * S_b of the workgroup's whole K range are computed once in the
prologue and staged in LDS, one ds_read per k-tile, so no scale state is
carried across the loop back edge (kernel us vs register-carried scales:
m=1024 9.20->8.84, m=2048 14.14->13.70,
m=4096 25.00->23.61).
"""

import functools

import torch

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import BFloat16, Float8E4M3FN, Float32, Int32, T
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm_d
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import vector as _vector_d
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _arith_d
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as _rocdl_d
from flydsl._mlir import ir as _ir
from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec

_N = 1024
_K = 4096
_BLK = 128


# Split partials cross XCDs, which do not share L2: write/read them with sc0|sc1.
_CPOL_COHERENT = 0x1 | 0x10

# GEMM A LDS swizzle: XOR the 16-byte chunk with (row >> 1) & 7, so the 16
# rows one ds_read_b128 quarter-wave touches cover all 64 banks once.
_A_SWZ = (3, 4, 4)


def _select_tiles(m):
    """(tile_m, tile_n, split_k, kgroups, xcd_remap) per M.

    kgroups=2 splits each WG's K range over two 256-thread groups (2 waves per
    SIMD) and sums them through LDS; xcd_remap=(mb, nb) gives each XCD one
    compact mb x nb block of tiles.  Graph-replay us (old table -> this one):
    m=256 17.05->16.4, m=512 19.0->17.3, m=1024 22.0->20.35, m=2048 26.8->25.4,
    m=4096 37.2->36.3.  The remap on a split-K=4 grid (m=256) cost +2 us, and
    kgroups=2 at m=4096 (already 2 waves/SIMD) cost +1 us.
    Re-swept on the U=4/B_DIST=3 body, harness-style (fresh input draw copied
    before each single-launch replay; a warm back-to-back loop misranks the
    split-K rows): m=512 remap (4,8) 17.52-17.58 vs (16,2) 17.64-17.72 over
    three interleaved runs; every other row held -- m=256 no-split-K kg2 +0.4,
    split-K 2 kg1 +0.3, split-K 4 +1.3; kg1 costs +0.15-0.3 at m=512..2048;
    a kgroups=4 variant lost 0.3-0.5 at m=256/512.
    Table-only probes on the merged (N-stacked m=4096 + m=128 decode remap)
    body, single-launch graph replay with a fresh A/S_a copy before each, 3
    rounds: m=1024 mgroups=2 x 32x64 remap (8,4) 19.40-19.72 / (4,8)
    19.52-19.59 vs 19.25-20.33, and m=2048 ngroups=2 x 64x64 24.79-24.94 vs
    23.49-23.93 -- both also MISCOMPUTE (rel err 0.37 / 0.24): multi-group
    WGs with num_acc_n=1 are not a legal configuration of kernel_gemm.
    """
    if m <= 64:
        return 32, 64, 8, 1, None
    if m <= 256:
        return 32, 64, 2, 2, (8, 4)
    if m <= 512:
        # kgroups=1 with LDS-staged scales: kernel us 6.65 -> 6.00 warm, but
        # harness 17.55 -> 18.2, so kgroups=2 (register-carried scales) stays.
        return 32, 64, 1, 2, (4, 8)
    if m <= 1024:
        return 32, 128, 1, 2, (8, 4)
    if m <= 2048:
        return 64, 128, 1, 2, (8, 4)
    if _select_ngroups(m) > 1:
        return 64, 128, 1, 1, _NG_REMAP
    return 64, 128, 1, 1, (4, 8) if _select_mgroups(m) > 1 else (8, 8)


# m=4096 body: 2 -> one 64x256 tile per 512-thread WG (N-stacked groups that
# share one A ring), 1 -> the 128x128 M-stacked body below.
_M4096_NGROUPS = 2
_NG_REMAP = (8, 4)


def _select_ngroups(m):
    """Groups of 256 threads stacked along N in one WG (each owns tile_n cols).

    Both groups compute the same 64 A rows: each loads half of the A tile into
    a shared LDS ring (register-staged) and reads the whole tile back, so
    per-CU A traffic per output column halves; each group loads its own B
    columns.

    m=4096 vs the mgroups=2 128x128 body (bit-exact output): 192 VGPR (204),
    48 KB LDS (80), no scratch; kernel-trace median 23.04 -> 21.72 us;
    TA busy -11.5%, TD busy -7%, TCP->TCC read req +8.5% (2.46M -> 2.67M),
    SQ_INSTS_LDS -9%, SQ_WAIT_INST_LDS -47%; harness us over three interleaved
    rounds 33.77-34.95 -> 32.34-33.37.  Remap (16,2) ties-to-+0.3, (32,1)
    +0.5, B_DIST=3 ties: (8,4) / B_DIST=2 kept.

    Ported onto the direct-A body (the ngroups path keeps the register-staged
    A ring): torch.equal vs the mgroups=2 direct-A body on 3 draws; m=4096
    192 VGPR / 0 AGPR / no scratch / 48 KB LDS (was 196 / 80 KB); m=256 and
    m=2048 ISA byte-identical.  Graph-replay us over 9 interleaved rounds:
    21.85-22.09 vs 22.96-23.59 (mgroups=2 direct A).
    Measured and dropped:
    * Direct async-LDS half-A on this body (each group DMAs its 32 rows, one
      barrier per k-tile): bit-exact, 22.43-22.64 vs 21.92-22.17 (+0.5).
    * Staged prologue issued in steady-state order (B0, A3, B1, A4): removes
      the loop-head vmcnt(0) (-> vmcnt(5) for the A write only) but ties,
      21.85-22.12 vs 21.87-22.09.
    * m=2048 as 64x256 N-stacked, split-K 2, partner-plane-only fixup by the
      last arriver, XCD remap (8,2,2) keeping split partners on one XCD:
      bit-exact, 192 VGPR, but 18.1-18.6 vs 13.6 (kg2 64x128).  Split: main
      loop alone 12.9 (-0.7), + fp32 plane stores / atomic 13.35, + the
      partner-plane read / add / bf16 store 18.2 (+4.9).  Non-coherent
      partner loads 18.2, non-coherent stores and loads 19.4: the fixup
      tail, not the cache policy, is the cost.

    Re-verified on this file (lane 1, iteration after iter_030): per-key
    VGPR/AGPR/scratch/LDS -- m=1,2 decode 180/0/0/4 KB; m=4..64 decode
    94/0/0/72 KB; m=128 decode 142/0/0/144 KB; m=256 76/0/0/40 KB; m=512
    96/0/0/40 KB; m=1024 136/0/0/52 KB; m=2048 202/74/0/104 KB; m=4096
    192/0/0/48 KB (iter_028: 196/68/0/80 KB).  Output torch.equal vs
    iter_028 on all 13 m values x 3 draws (so allclose too); instruction
    stream byte-identical to iter_028 on the 12 keys other than m=4096.
    Single-launch graph replay with a fresh input copy before each launch,
    mean of 200, three interleaved rounds: m=4096 31.93 / 31.92 / 31.86 vs
    iter_028 33.29 / 32.88 / 32.98; warm 50-launch graph (kernel us) 22.03 /
    21.80 / 21.63 vs 23.45 / 22.67 / 22.41; m=2048 23.70 / 23.80 / 23.52 vs
    23.91 / 23.59 / 23.43 (same ISA).  Moving the half-A global load into
    the MFMA interleave (one more VMEM group slot) ties, 31.84-32.48 vs
    31.90-32.24, at +8 VGPR (200): dropped.  The m=2048 split-K step and
    the direct async-LDS half-A were not rebuilt: iter_030's measurements
    above already meet their abandon rules (fixup +4.9 us vs loop -0.7;
    direct half-A +0.5 us).
    """
    return _M4096_NGROUPS if m > 2048 else 1


def _select_mgroups(m):
    """Groups of 256 threads stacked along M in one WG (each owns tile_m rows).

    m=4096: 2 x 64x128 = one 128x128 tile per 512-thread WG (204 VGPR, 80 KB
    LDS, no scratch).  Both groups load identical B addresses, which merge in
    the CU's L1: TCP->TCC read requests 3.21M -> 2.47M; harness us over three
    interleaved rounds 34.06-34.42 -> 33.73-33.81.  Remap (8,4) ties (4,8);
    B_DIST=3 on this config costs +0.4 us kernel time.
    """
    return 2 if m > 2048 and _select_ngroups(m) == 1 else 1


def _atomic_add_agent(addr_i64, val):
    ptr = _llvm_d.IntToPtrOp(_llvm_d.PointerType.get(address_space=1), fx.Int64(addr_i64).ir_value()).result
    return _llvm_d.AtomicRMWOp(
        _llvm_d.AtomicBinOp.add,
        ptr,
        fx.Int32(val).ir_value(),
        _llvm_d.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
        syncscope=fx.rocdl.SyncScope.Agent,
    ).res


def _check_remap(grid, remap):
    """Assert the XCD remap used in the kernel is a bijection onto the grid."""
    gx, gy, gz = grid
    mb, nb = remap
    G = gx * gy * gz
    assert G % 8 == 0 and gx % mb == 0 and gy % nb == 0 and mb * nb == G // 8
    bpm, bpn = gx // mb, gy // nb
    seen = set()
    for lin in range(G):
        xcd, w = lin % 8, lin // 8
        z, r = xcd // (bpm * bpn), xcd % (bpm * bpn)
        t = ((r % bpm) * mb + w % mb, (r // bpm) * nb + w // mb, z)
        assert t[0] < gx and t[1] < gy and t[2] < gz
        seen.add(t)
    assert len(seen) == G


def _unwrap(v):
    return v.ir_value() if hasattr(v, "ir_value") else v


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def _compile_blockscale_gemm(
    M: int, N: int, K: int, tile_m: int, tile_n: int, split_k: int, kgroups: int = 1, remap=None,
    mgroups: int = 1, ngroups: int = 1,
):
    tile_k = 128
    _SWZ = _A_SWZ
    # Main loop: U k-tiles per iteration, NB B register slots, B issued B_DIST
    # steps ahead, interleaved with the step's MFMAs.  With the A register
    # double buffer (back-to-back kernel us, 20-launch graph): B_DIST=2 vs 3
    # m=1024 8.94 vs 9.36, m=2048 13.72 vs 14.66, m=4096 24.62 vs 25.11.
    U = 4
    NB = 4
    B_DIST = 2
    # A LDS: 4-stage ring with one barrier per two k-tiles; step t writes
    # A(t+WD) and issues A(t+WD+2).  Kernel us (50-launch graph) vs one
    # barrier per k-tile on 2 stages: m=512 6.13->6.09, m=2048 13.09->12.96,
    # m=4096 22.81->22.87 (neutral to slightly better).
    NS = 4
    WD = 3
    # Multi-group WGs: A goes global -> LDS directly (async buffer_load_dwordx4
    # ... lds, no VGPR staging copy, no ds_write), step t issues A(t+AD) into
    # stage (t+AD)%NS with a barrier every A_BAR steps.  Bit-exact vs the
    # register-staged ring; graph-replay kernel us (staged -> direct):
    # m=256 6.23->6.16, m=512 6.22->6.06, m=1024 8.26->8.30, m=2048
    # 12.87->12.56, m=4096 22.28->22.05 (VGPR 204->196).  AD=3 / A_BAR=2
    # (the only other legal NS=4 ring) waits on a same-step load: m=4096
    # 23.18.  B_DIST=3 on this body: m=4096 +0.75, m=2048 +0.17.  The
    # asyncmark waits are subsumed by each step's in-order vmcnt wait for B
    # (ISA: no vmcnt wait precedes a step's first ds_read_b128 after its
    # buffer_load ... lds, so the LDS-alias wait is inactive).
    # With the prologue issued in steady-state order, the loop-head wait is
    # vmcnt(10) at m=2048/4096 (was 8), vmcnt(5) at m=512 (was 4), and
    # vmcnt(8) at m=1024 direct (was 3); the prologue asyncmark lowers to
    # exactly 2*nA + 2*nB in flight.  m=1024 (32x128 kg2) still prefers the
    # register-staged ring (same ISA as before direct A): kernel us over 7
    # interleaved rounds, staged 10.51-10.61 vs direct 10.62-10.67.
    # Bit-exact on m=256..4096; scratch 0 everywhere.
    direct_a = (mgroups > 1 or kgroups > 1) and not (tile_m == 32 and tile_n == 128)
    AD = 4
    A_BAR = 1
    SK = K // _BLK
    elem_bytes = 1
    layout_elem = Float8E4M3FN
    out_elem_cls = BFloat16

    num_tiles = K // tile_k // split_k // kgroups
    assert num_tiles % 2 == 0 and num_tiles >= 2 and (K // tile_k) % (split_k * kgroups) == 0
    assert kgroups in (1, 2)
    assert mgroups in (1, 2) and not (mgroups > 1 and kgroups > 1)
    assert ngroups in (1, 2) and not (ngroups > 1 and (kgroups > 1 or mgroups > 1))
    m_repeat = tile_m // 16
    num_waves = 4
    n_per_wave = tile_n // num_waves
    num_acc_n = n_per_wave // 16
    assert num_acc_n >= 1
    acc_size = m_repeat * num_acc_n * 4
    grp_threads = 256
    total_threads = grp_threads * kgroups * mgroups * ngroups
    a_load_bytes = 16
    num_a_loads = (tile_m * tile_k * elem_bytes) // grp_threads // a_load_bytes
    assert num_a_loads >= 1

    wg_m = tile_m * mgroups
    M_pad = ((M + wg_m - 1) // wg_m) * wg_m
    a_lds_elems = tile_m * tile_k
    grid = (M_pad // wg_m, N // (tile_n * ngroups), split_k)
    if remap is not None:
        _check_remap(grid, remap)

    @fx.struct
    class SharedStorage:
        a: fx.Array[layout_elem, NS * kgroups * mgroups * a_lds_elems, 16]
        if kgroups == 1 or num_acc_n >= 2:
            scl: fx.Array[Float32, kgroups * mgroups * ngroups * num_tiles * tile_m, 16]
        if kgroups > 1:
            red: fx.Array[Float32, tile_m * tile_n, 16]
        if split_k > 1:
            split_flag: fx.Array[Int32, 1, 4]

    @flyc.kernel
    def kernel_gemm(
        arg_c: fx.Tensor,
        arg_ws: fx.Tensor,
        arg_sem: fx.Tensor,
        arg_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_b: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_b: fx.Tensor,
        tiled_copy_g2s: fx.TiledCopy,
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bid_x, bid_y, bid_z = fx.block_idx
        if const_expr(remap is not None):
            # XCD-aware WG -> tile map: WGs are dispatched round-robin over the
            # 8 XCDs by linear id, so XCD c runs lin = c, c+8, ...  Give each
            # XCD one compact (mb x nb) block of tiles so its L2 serves the
            # A rows / B columns that block shares.
            gx, gy, _gz = grid
            mb, nb = remap
            P = gx * gy * _gz // 8
            bpm = gx // mb
            bpn = gy // nb
            lin = fx.Int32(bid_x) + fx.Int32(bid_y) * gx + fx.Int32(bid_z) * (gx * gy)
            xcd = lin % 8
            w = lin // 8
            zz = xcd // (bpm * bpn)
            rr = xcd % (bpm * bpn)
            bid_x = (rr % bpm) * mb + w % mb
            bid_y = (rr // bpm) * nb + w // mb
            bid_z = zz
        if const_expr(mgroups > 1):
            # Two 256-thread groups stacked along M: group mg computes the
            # 64-row block 2*bid_x + mg; both read the same B columns.
            tid_g = tid % grp_threads
            mg = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(tid // grp_threads)))
            bid_x = fx.Int32(bid_x) * mgroups + mg
            k_off = fx.Int32(bid_z) * num_tiles
        elif const_expr(ngroups > 1):
            # Two 256-thread groups stacked along N: group ng computes the
            # 128-col block 2*bid_y + ng; both use the same 64 A rows.
            tid_g = tid % grp_threads
            ng = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(tid // grp_threads)))
            bid_y = fx.Int32(bid_y) * ngroups + ng
            k_off = fx.Int32(bid_z) * num_tiles
        elif const_expr(kgroups == 1):
            tid_g = tid
            k_off = fx.Int32(bid_z) * num_tiles
        else:
            tid_g = tid % grp_threads
            kg = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(tid // grp_threads)))
            k_off = (fx.Int32(bid_z) * kgroups + kg) * num_tiles

        _scale_atom = fx.make_mma_atom(fx.rocdl.cdna4.MFMA_Scale(16, 16, 128, layout_elem))
        tiled_mma = fx.make_tiled_mma(
            _scale_atom,
            fx.make_layout((1, 4, 1), (0, 1, 0)),
            fx.make_tile(None, None, fx.make_layout((32, 4), (1, 32))),
        )

        gA = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_a, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * K * elem_bytes)
        gB = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_b)
        gC = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_c, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * N * 2)
        if const_expr(split_k > 1):
            ws_plane = fx.Tensor(
                fx.make_view(
                    fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(arg_ws), fx.Int64(bid_z) * fx.Int64(M_pad * N)),
                    fx.make_layout((M_pad, N), (N, 1)),
                )
            )
            gW = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(ws_plane, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * N * 4)

        tA = fx.flat_divide(gA, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_k))[None, None, bid_x, None]
        tB = fx.flat_divide(gB, fx.make_tile(tile_n, tile_k))[None, None, bid_y, None]
        tC = fx.flat_divide(gC, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_n))[None, None, bid_x, bid_y]

        buf_copy = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), layout_elem)
        uni_copy = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), layout_elem)

        thr_mma = tiled_mma.thr_slice(tid_g)
        thr_g2s = tiled_copy_g2s.get_slice(tid_g)
        thr_s2r = fx.make_tiled_copy_A(buf_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(tid_g)
        thr_g2r_B = fx.make_tiled_copy_B(buf_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(tid_g)

        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SharedStorage).peek()
        k_blocks16 = (tile_k * elem_bytes) // 16
        swz_bits = k_blocks16.bit_length() - 1
        swz = fx.SwizzleType.get(*_SWZ)

        def _make_sA(ptr):
            return fx.make_view(
                ptr,
                fx.make_composed_layout(
                    fx.static(swz),
                    fx.make_ordered_layout((tile_m, tile_k), (1, 0)),
                ),
            )

        if const_expr(mgroups > 1):
            sA_stages = [
                _make_sA(fx.add_offset(lds.a.ptr, (mg * NS + st) * a_lds_elems)) for st in range(NS)
            ]
        elif const_expr(kgroups == 1 or ngroups > 1):
            sA_stages = [_make_sA(fx.add_offset(lds.a.ptr, st * a_lds_elems)) for st in range(NS)]
        else:
            sA_stages = [
                _make_sA(fx.add_offset(lds.a.ptr, (kg * NS + st) * a_lds_elems)) for st in range(NS)
            ]

        pA_g = thr_g2s.partition_S(tA)
        pA_s_stages = [thr_g2s.partition_D(s) for s in sA_stages]
        pA_s2r_stages = [thr_s2r.partition_S(s) for s in sA_stages]
        pB_g = thr_g2r_B.partition_S(tB)

        if const_expr(ngroups > 1):
            # Shared A ring: group ng loads / writes rows [32*ng, 32*ng + 32)
            # of each stage (the half offset 4096 B has no swizzle-source or
            # swizzled bits set, so the half view's writes land where the
            # full-tile reads expect them); both read the whole tile.
            half_m = tile_m // ngroups
            tA_h = fx.flat_divide(gA, fx.make_tile(half_m, tile_k))[None, None, fx.Int32(bid_x) * ngroups + ng, None]
            sA_half = [
                fx.make_view(
                    fx.add_offset(lds.a.ptr, st * a_lds_elems + ng * (half_m * tile_k)),
                    fx.make_composed_layout(
                        fx.static(swz),
                        fx.make_ordered_layout((half_m, tile_k), (1, 0)),
                    ),
                )
                for st in range(NS)
            ]
            pA_g = thr_g2s.partition_S(tA_h)
            pA_s_stages = [thr_g2s.partition_D(h) for h in sA_half]
        frag_copy_A_sets = [fx.make_fragment_like(pA_s_stages[0][None, None, None]) for _ in range(2)]
        frag_A = thr_mma.make_fragment_A(sA_stages[0])
        frag_B_single_layout = thr_mma.partition_B(tB).layout(None, None, None, 0)
        frag_B_stages = [fx.make_fragment_like(frag_B_single_layout, layout_elem.ir_type) for _ in range(NB)]
        frag_C = thr_mma.make_fragment_C(tC)
        frag_A_retile = thr_s2r.retile(frag_A)
        frag_B_retile_stages = [thr_g2r_B.retile(b) for b in frag_B_stages]

        # ── scale operands ──────────────────────────────────────────
        sa_t = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_scale_a, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * SK * 4)
        sa_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(sa_t))

        bx_m = bid_x * tile_m
        by_n = bid_y * tile_n
        lane_id = tid % 64
        lane_mod_16 = lane_id % 16
        lane_div_16 = lane_id // 16
        wave_id = tid_g // 64

        # The MFMA is issued as C^T = B * A^T (the 16x16x128 A and B operands
        # share one lane layout), so lane l owns, per (mi, ni), output row
        # m = bx_m + mi*16 + l%16 and 4 consecutive columns
        # n = by_n + ni*64 + wave*16 + (l//16)*4 + {0..3}.
        m_lane = bx_m + lane_mod_16
        n_lane = by_n + wave_id * 16 + lane_div_16 * 4

        # The whole workgroup's N range sits inside one 128-wide scale block
        # (tile_n divides 128), so S_b is one uniform value per k-tile.  The
        # whole S_b row (SK <= 64 values) is loaded once in the prologue, one
        # value per lane, and each k-tile reads its value with v_readlane: no
        # SMEM traffic in the loop, so the LDS waits never need lgkmcnt(0)
        # for an outstanding scalar load.
        assert tile_n <= _BLK and _BLK % tile_n == 0
        assert SK <= 64
        sb_t = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_scale_b)
        sb_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(sb_t))
        sb_row = fx.Int32(bid_y) >> ((_BLK // tile_n).bit_length() - 1)
        # Scale products S_a[row, kt] * S_b[kt] for the group's whole K range
        # are computed once in the prologue and staged in LDS as
        # scl[kt][row % 16][row // 16], so each step reads its lane's m_repeat
        # values with one ds_read and nothing scale-related is loop-carried.
        # (kgroups=2 with a single 16-col block per wave, m<=512, stays on the
        # loop-carried register path: the LDS-staged variant miscomputes
        # there.)
        lds_scl = kgroups == 1 or num_acc_n >= 2
        n_scl = num_tiles * tile_m
        scl_per_thr = n_scl // grp_threads
        assert scl_per_thr in (1, 2, 4, 8) and n_scl % grp_threads == 0
        if const_expr(mgroups > 1):
            scl_base = mg * n_scl
        elif const_expr(ngroups > 1):
            scl_base = ng * n_scl
        elif const_expr(kgroups == 1):
            scl_base = 0
        else:
            scl_base = kg * n_scl

        def stage_scales_issue():
            r = tid_g % tile_m
            kt0 = (tid_g // tile_m) * scl_per_thr
            a_off = ((bx_m + r) * SK + k_off + kt0) * 4
            b_off = (sb_row * SK + k_off + kt0) * 4
            nv = min(scl_per_thr, 4)
            ty = T.i32 if nv == 1 else T.vec(nv, T.i32)
            loads = []
            for h in range_constexpr(scl_per_thr // nv):
                la = rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(ty, sa_rsrc, fx.Int32(a_off + h * 16), fx.Int32(0))
                lb = rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(ty, sb_rsrc, fx.Int32(b_off + h * 16), fx.Int32(0))
                loads.append((_unwrap(la), _unwrap(lb)))
            return r, kt0, nv, loads

        def stage_scales_write(st):
            r, kt0, nv, loads = st
            for h in range_constexpr(len(loads)):
                la, lb = loads[h]
                for j in range_constexpr(nv):
                    if const_expr(nv == 1):
                        ea, eb = la, lb
                    else:
                        ea = _vector_d.extract(la, static_position=[j], dynamic_position=[])
                        eb = _vector_d.extract(lb, static_position=[j], dynamic_position=[])
                    fa = fx.Float32(_arith_d.bitcast(Float32.ir_type, ea))
                    fb = fx.Float32(_arith_d.bitcast(Float32.ir_type, eb))
                    kt = kt0 + h * nv + j
                    idx = scl_base + (kt * 16 + r % 16) * m_repeat + r // 16
                    fx.ptr_store(Vec.from_elements([fa * fb], Float32), fx.add_offset(lds.scl.ptr, idx))

        # Register path: per-k-tile A-scale column through ds_bpermute, S_b
        # row in one VGPR read with v_readlane, issued one iteration ahead.
        blocks_per_load = min(4, m_repeat)
        n_sa_loads = (m_repeat + 3) // 4
        sa_voff = (bx_m + lane_mod_16 + (lane_div_16 % blocks_per_load) * 16) * (SK * 4)
        sa_perm_idx = [(lane_mod_16 + j * 16) * 4 for j in range(blocks_per_load)]

        def _bperm_sa(raw_tile):
            return [
                fx.Float32(
                    _arith_d.bitcast(
                        Float32.ir_type,
                        rocdl.ds_bpermute(T.i32, fx.Int32(sa_perm_idx[mi % 4]), raw_tile[mi // 4]),
                    )
                )
                for mi in range_constexpr(m_repeat)
            ]

        def issue_sb_row():
            return rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                T.i32, sb_rsrc, fx.Int32((sb_row * SK + lane_id % SK) * 4), fx.Int32(0)
            )

        def issue_scales(kt0):
            kt_off = sa_voff + fx.Int32(kt0) * 4
            raw = [
                rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                    T.vec(U, T.i32), sa_rsrc, fx.Int32(kt_off + h * 64 * SK * 4), fx.Int32(0)
                )
                for h in range_constexpr(n_sa_loads)
            ]
            return [_unwrap(r) for r in raw]

        def scales_half(sc, h, vsb, kt):
            sa_raw = [_vector_d.extract(r, static_position=[h], dynamic_position=[]) for r in sc[:n_sa_loads]]
            sb_i = rocdl.readlane(T.i32, vsb, fx.Int32(k_off + kt))
            sb = fx.Float32(_arith_d.bitcast(Float32.ir_type, _unwrap(sb_i)))
            return sa_raw, sb

        def read_scales(kt):
            v = fx.make_view(
                fx.add_offset(lds.scl.ptr, scl_base + (kt * 16 + lane_mod_16) * m_repeat),
                fx.make_layout(m_repeat, 1),
            ).load()
            vv = Vec(v)
            return [vv[mi] for mi in range_constexpr(m_repeat)]

        acc_zero = Vec.filled(acc_size, 0.0, Float32)
        v4f32 = T.vec(4, T.f32)
        v8i32 = T.vec(8, T.i32)
        zero4 = Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32).ir_value()

        def _i32_slices(vec_val, count):
            n_i32 = count * 8
            as_i32 = _vector_d.bitcast(T.vec(n_i32, T.i32), vec_val)
            return [
                _vector_d.extract_strided_slice(v8i32, as_i32, [j * 8], [8], [1]) for j in range(count)
            ]

        def read_A(a_stage):
            fx.copy(uni_copy, pA_s2r_stages[a_stage][None, None, 0], frag_A_retile[None, None, 0])
            return Vec(frag_A.load()).ir_value()

        def mma_issue(a_val, cur_frag_B):
            a_regs = _i32_slices(a_val, m_repeat)
            b_regs = _i32_slices(Vec(cur_frag_B.load()).ir_value(), num_acc_n)
            return [
                [
                    rocdl.mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4(
                        v4f32, [b_regs[ni], a_regs[mi], zero4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
                    )
                    for ni in range_constexpr(num_acc_n)
                ]
                for mi in range_constexpr(m_repeat)
            ]

        def mma_scale_s(parts, srows):
            acc = Vec(frag_C.load()).ir_value()
            for mi in range_constexpr(m_repeat):
                sv = Vec.filled(4, srows[mi], Float32)
                for ni in range_constexpr(num_acc_n):
                    off = (mi * num_acc_n + ni) * 4
                    old = _vector_d.extract_strided_slice(v4f32, acc, [off], [4], [1])
                    new = Vec(fx.math.fma(Vec(parts[mi][ni]), sv, Vec(old))).ir_value()
                    acc = _vector_d.insert_strided_slice(new, acc, [off], [1])
            frag_C.store(Vec(acc))

        # Software pipeline, one barrier per two k-tiles.
        def issue_A(kt, slot):
            fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, k_off + kt], frag_copy_A_sets[slot])

        def issue_B(kt, slot):
            fx.copy(buf_copy, pB_g[None, None, None, k_off + kt], frag_B_retile_stages[slot])

        def write_A(slot, stage=None):
            stage = slot if stage is None else stage
            fx.copy(uni_copy, frag_copy_A_sets[slot], pA_s_stages[stage][None, None, None])

        if const_expr(direct_a):
            # Direct global -> LDS A load.  Instruction j of wave w writes the
            # 1 KB (8 rows) at stage_base + (w + 4j) * 1024, lane i at +16 i:
            # row r = 8 (w + 4j) + i // 8, stored chunk i % 8.  The image must
            # match _A_SWZ (stored chunk = chunk ^ ((r >> 1) & 7)), so lane i
            # fetches global chunk (i & 7) ^ ((4 w + i // 16) & 7).
            assert tile_k == 128 and num_a_loads * 32 == tile_m
            a_grp = mg if mgroups > 1 else kg
            a_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(gA))
            wave_u = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(tid_g // 64)))
            lane_a = tid_g % 64
            chunk_a = (lane_a % 8) ^ ((wave_id * 4 + lane_a // 16) % 8)
            a_voff = [
                ((bx_m + (wave_id + 4 * j) * 8 + lane_a // 8) * K + chunk_a * 16)
                for j in range(num_a_loads)
            ]
            a_voff = [_unwrap(fx.Int32(v)) for v in a_voff]
            c16 = _unwrap(fx.Int32(16))
            c0 = _unwrap(fx.Int32(0))
            aux0 = _ir.IntegerAttr.get(_ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32), 0)

            def issue_A_lds(kt, stage):
                soff = _unwrap(fx.Int32((k_off + kt) * tile_k))
                for j in range_constexpr(num_a_loads):
                    lds_p = fx.add_offset(
                        lds.a.ptr, (a_grp * NS + stage) * a_lds_elems + (wave_u + 4 * j) * 1024
                    ).llvm_ptr
                    _rocdl_d.raw_ptr_buffer_load_async_lds(
                        a_rsrc, lds_p, c16, a_voff[j], soff, c0, aux=aux0
                    )
                rocdl.asyncmark()

        # A copy-register slot j holds the A k-tiles of parity j; LDS stage
        # j (of NS=4) holds the A k-tiles with t % 4 == j.  A(t) enters step t
        # already in VGPRs (read from LDS during step t-1).  Step t: issue the
        # scale bpermutes, write A(t+3) from slot (t+3)%2 into stage (t+3)%4
        # (A(t-1) there was read in step t-2, before the last barrier), read
        # A(t+1) from stage (t+1)%4 (written in step t-2) into registers, MFMAs
        # on A(t) x B(t) interleaved with B(t+B_DIST) loads, refill the slot
        # with A(t+5), fma the scaled partials; a barrier ends every odd step.
        # Every A global load gets two full steps before its LDS write.
        # B(t) lives in register slot t % NB, issued B_DIST steps ahead.
        acur = [None]

        def step(p, kt, t_static, sc=None, vsb=None):
            # t_static: static k-tile index in the peeled tail, None in the loop.
            def live(d):
                return t_static is None or t_static + d < num_tiles

            a_now = acur[0]
            # Early: the scale bpermutes and the A(t+WD) LDS write go first,
            # so neither the scale fma nor the end barrier waits behind them
            # (vs at the end of the step: m=512 6.37->6.17, m=4096 23.5->22.9).
            if const_expr(lds_scl):
                srows = read_scales(kt)
            else:
                sa_raw, sb = scales_half(sc, p % U, vsb, kt)
                srows = [r * sb for r in _bperm_sa(sa_raw)]
            if const_expr(direct_a):
                if const_expr(live(AD)):
                    issue_A_lds(kt + AD, (p + AD) % NS)
            elif const_expr(live(WD)):
                write_A((p + WD) % 2, (p + WD) % NS)
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            if const_expr(live(1)):
                acur[0] = read_A((p + 1) % NS)
            parts = mma_issue(a_now, frag_B_stages[p % NB])
            if const_expr(live(B_DIST)):
                issue_B(kt + B_DIST, (p + B_DIST) % NB)
            # Interleave: each MFMA is followed by its share of the A(t+1)
            # ds_reads and B(t+B_DIST) global loads, so the LDS / VMEM issue
            # hides under the MFMA stream instead of serializing before it.
            n_mf = m_repeat * num_acc_n
            n_rd = 2 * m_repeat if live(1) else 0
            n_vm = 2 * num_acc_n if live(B_DIST) else 0
            for i in range_constexpr(n_mf):
                rocdl.sched_group_barrier(0x008, 1, 0)
                r = n_rd // n_mf + (1 if i < n_rd % n_mf else 0)
                if const_expr(r > 0):
                    rocdl.sched_group_barrier(0x100, r, 0)
                v = n_vm // n_mf + (1 if i < n_vm % n_mf else 0)
                if const_expr(v > 0):
                    rocdl.sched_group_barrier(0x020, v, 0)
            # Wall: keep the fma (which waits on the MFMA results) after the
            # whole MFMA stream.
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            if const_expr(not direct_a and live(WD + 2)):
                issue_A(kt + WD + 2, (p + WD) % 2)
            mma_scale_s(parts, srows)
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            if const_expr(direct_a):
                if const_expr(live(1) and (p + 1) % A_BAR == 0):
                    # A(t+2 .. t+A_BAR+1) are read before the next barrier;
                    # the younger A groups may stay in flight.
                    if const_expr(t_static is None):
                        n_out = AD - A_BAR - 1
                    else:
                        n_out = max(0, min(t_static + AD, num_tiles - 1) - (t_static + A_BAR + 1))
                    rocdl.wait_asyncmark(n_out)
                    gpu.barrier()
                    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            elif const_expr(live(1) and p % 2 == 1):
                gpu.barrier()
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)

        # ── prologue ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # The S_b row goes first so the in-order vmcnt wait for A0 retires it.
        if const_expr(lds_scl):
            scl_st = stage_scales_issue()
        else:
            vsb0 = issue_sb_row()
            sc0 = issue_scales(k_off)
        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        # A0..A2 go through prologue-only register sets straight into
        # stages 0..2; A3 / A4 land in the loop's copy slots 1 / 0.
        assert num_tiles >= 8
        if const_expr(direct_a):
            assert AD <= NS and A_BAR in (1, 2) and AD >= A_BAR + 1 and NS >= AD + A_BAR - 1
            # Issue in the steady-state VMEM order (step t issues A(t+AD) then
            # B(t+B_DIST)): A0 .. A(AD-B_DIST-1), then A(AD-B_DIST+j), B(j).
            # The loop-head vmcnt is the min over the preheader and latch
            # paths, so a prologue that issues both B tiles last forces a
            # deeper wait on the first step of every iteration.
            for j in range_constexpr(AD - B_DIST):
                issue_A_lds(fx.Int32(j), j % NS)
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            for j in range_constexpr(B_DIST):
                issue_A_lds(fx.Int32(AD - B_DIST + j), (AD - B_DIST + j) % NS)
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                issue_B(j, j % NB)
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            frag_C.store(acc_zero)
            if const_expr(lds_scl):
                stage_scales_write(scl_st)
            rocdl.wait_asyncmark(AD - A_BAR - 1)
        else:
            tmp_sets = [fx.make_fragment_like(pA_s_stages[0][None, None, None]) for _ in range(3)]
            for j in range_constexpr(3):
                fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, k_off + j], tmp_sets[j])
            for j in range_constexpr(B_DIST):
                issue_B(j, j % NB)
            issue_A(3, 1)
            issue_A(4, 0)
            frag_C.store(acc_zero)
            if const_expr(lds_scl):
                stage_scales_write(scl_st)
            for j in range_constexpr(3):
                fx.copy(uni_copy, tmp_sets[j], pA_s_stages[j][None, None, None])
        gpu.barrier()
        acur[0] = read_A(0)
        # Step 0 overwrites stage 0: every wave must have read A(0) first.
        gpu.barrier()
        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)

        assert num_tiles >= 4 and num_tiles % U == 0
        loop_end = (num_tiles - 4) // U

        n_cp = 0 if direct_a else 2

        def _state():
            return [frag_C.load()] + [frag_copy_A_sets[j].load() for j in range_constexpr(n_cp)] + [
                frag_B_stages[j].load() for j in range_constexpr(NB)
            ] + [acur[0]]

        n_st = 2 + n_cp + NB

        def _restore(st):
            frag_C.store(st[0])
            for j in range_constexpr(n_cp):
                frag_copy_A_sets[j].store(st[1 + j])
            for j in range_constexpr(NB):
                frag_B_stages[j].store(st[1 + n_cp + j])
            acur[0] = _unwrap(st[1 + n_cp + NB])

        if const_expr(loop_end > 0):
            if const_expr(lds_scl):
                init = _state()
                for iv, state in range(0, loop_end, 1, init=init):
                    _restore(state)
                    kb0 = fx.Int32(iv * U)
                    for p in range_constexpr(U):
                        step(p, kb0 + fx.Int32(p), None)
                    results = yield _state()
                _restore(results)
            else:
                init = _state() + [vsb0] + sc0
                for iv, state in range(0, loop_end, 1, init=init):
                    _restore(state)
                    vsb_in = state[n_st]
                    sc_in = [state[n_st + 1 + i] for i in range(n_sa_loads)]
                    kb0 = fx.Int32(iv * U)
                    sc_next = issue_scales(k_off + kb0 + fx.Int32(U))
                    for p in range_constexpr(U):
                        step(p, kb0 + fx.Int32(p), None, sc_in, vsb_in)
                    results = yield _state() + [vsb_in] + sc_next
                _restore(results)
                vsb0 = results[n_st]
                sc0 = [results[n_st + 1 + i] for i in range(n_sa_loads)]
        # Peeled tail: the last 4 k-tiles (num_tiles % U == 0, so slot indices
        # continue from the loop).
        for q in range_constexpr(4):
            kt_q = num_tiles - 4 + q
            if const_expr(lds_scl):
                step(q, fx.Int32(kt_q), kt_q)
            else:
                step(q, fx.Int32(kt_q), kt_q, sc0, vsb0)

        acc_out = Vec(frag_C.load()).ir_value()

        def _acc4(mi, ni):
            off = (mi * num_acc_n + ni) * 4
            return _vector_d.extract_strided_slice(v4f32, acc_out, [off], [4], [1])

        if const_expr(kgroups == 1):
            out_rows = [
                [(m_lane + mi * 16, _acc4(mi, ni)) for ni in range(num_acc_n)] for mi in range(m_repeat)
            ]
        else:
            # Balanced half-exchange: group g keeps row blocks [g*half, (g+1)*half),
            # sends the other half to its partner through LDS, adds the partner's
            # half of its own rows and stores them.
            half = m_repeat // 2
            is0 = _unwrap(kg == fx.Int32(0))
            keeps = []
            for j in range_constexpr(half):
                row_keep = []
                for ni in range_constexpr(num_acc_n):
                    lo = _acc4(j, ni)
                    hi = _acc4(half + j, ni)
                    send = _arith_d.select(is0, hi, lo)
                    row_keep.append(_arith_d.select(is0, lo, hi))
                    dst = ((((fx.Int32(1) - kg) * half + j) * num_acc_n + ni) * grp_threads + tid_g) * 4
                    fx.ptr_store(Vec(send), fx.add_offset(lds.red.ptr, dst))
                keeps.append(row_keep)
            gpu.barrier()
            out_rows = []
            for j in range_constexpr(half):
                row = []
                for ni in range_constexpr(num_acc_n):
                    src = (((kg * half + j) * num_acc_n + ni) * grp_threads + tid_g) * 4
                    other = fx.make_view(fx.add_offset(lds.red.ptr, src), fx.make_layout(4, 1)).load()
                    tot = Vec(keeps[j][ni]) + Vec(other)
                    row.append((m_lane + (kg * half + j) * 16, tot.ir_value()))
                out_rows.append(row)

        def _store_tile(rsrc, elem_bytes_out, cvt, aux):
            # Rows >= M fall outside rsrc's num_records and are dropped.
            for row in out_rows:
                for ni in range_constexpr(num_acc_n):
                    r, val = row[ni]
                    voff = (r * N + n_lane + ni * num_waves * 16) * elem_bytes_out
                    _rocdl_d.RawPtrBufferStoreOp(
                        cvt(val), rsrc, fx.Int32(voff).ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                        aux=_ir.IntegerAttr.get(_ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32), aux),
                    )

        if const_expr(split_k == 1):
            c_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(gC))
            _store_tile(
                c_rsrc, 2,
                lambda v: _vector_d.bitcast(T.vec(2, T.i32), Vec(v).to(out_elem_cls).ir_value()),
                0,
            )
        else:
            w_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(gW))
            _store_tile(w_rsrc, 4, lambda v: v, _CPOL_COHERENT)
            rocdl.s_waitcnt(0)
            gpu.barrier()
            sem_addr = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(fx.get_iter(arg_sem))) + fx.Int64(
                fx.Int32(bid_x) * (N // tile_n) + fx.Int32(bid_y)
            ) * fx.Int64(4)
            if tid == fx.Int32(0):
                arrival = fx.Int32(_atomic_add_agent(sem_addr, 1))
                is_last_t = (arrival == fx.Int32(split_k - 1)).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
                fx.ptr_store(Vec.from_elements([is_last_t], Int32), lds.split_flag.ptr)
            gpu.barrier()
            is_last = Vec(fx.make_view(lds.split_flag.ptr, fx.make_layout(1, 1)).load())[0]
            if is_last != fx.Int32(0):
                ws_all = fx.Tensor(
                    fx.make_view(fx.get_iter(arg_ws), fx.make_layout((M_pad, N), (N, 1)))
                )
                gWa = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(ws_all)
                tWa = fx.flat_divide(gWa, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_n))[None, None, bid_x, bid_y]
                VEC = 4
                tn_thr = tile_n // VEC
                tm_thr = total_threads // tn_thr
                tiler_mn, tv = fx.make_layout_tv(
                    fx.make_layout((tm_thr, tn_thr), (tn_thr, 1)),
                    fx.make_layout((1, VEC), (1, 1)),
                )
                load_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(_CPOL_COHERENT), Float32)

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def _compile_decode_gemm(
    M: int, N: int, K: int, tile_m: int, num_kw: int, a_lds: bool, remap: bool = False
):
    """Small-M path: one WG per (m-tile, n16) column, K split across its waves.

    Wave w owns k-tiles [w*T, (w+1)*T).  A and B go straight from global into
    the MFMA operand registers (all loads issued up front; with a_lds, A is
    loaded row-coalesced and hopped through a per-wave LDS area instead, which
    halves the cache lines each A load touches), the per-wave fp32
    partials are summed through LDS behind a single barrier, and wave 0 writes
    bf16.  No workspace, semaphore or atomics.
    """
    tile_k = 128
    tile_n = 16
    SK = K // _BLK
    layout_elem = Float8E4M3FN
    out_elem_cls = BFloat16
    n_ktiles = K // tile_k
    assert n_ktiles % num_kw == 0
    T_per = n_ktiles // num_kw
    m_repeat = tile_m // 16
    acc_size = m_repeat * 4
    total_threads = 64 * num_kw
    M_pad = ((M + tile_m - 1) // tile_m) * tile_m
    gx, gy = M_pad // tile_m, N // tile_n
    if remap:
        assert gy % 8 == 0
        seen = set()
        for lin in range(gx * gy):
            w = lin // 8
            t = (w % gx, (lin % 8) * (gy // 8) + w // gx)
            assert t[0] < gx and t[1] < gy
            seen.add(t)
        assert len(seen) == gx * gy

    @fx.struct
    class SharedStorage:
        red: fx.Array[Float32, num_kw * 64 * acc_size, 16]
        if a_lds:
            a_st: fx.Array[layout_elem, num_kw * T_per * tile_m * tile_k, 16]

    @flyc.kernel
    def kernel_decode(
        arg_c: fx.Tensor,
        arg_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_b: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_b: fx.Tensor,
        tiled_copy_g2s: fx.TiledCopy,
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bid_x, bid_y, bid_z = fx.block_idx
        if const_expr(remap):
            # XCD c (WGs lin = c, c+8, ...) gets n16 columns [c*gy/8, (c+1)*gy/8)
            # for every m-block, so each B column is fetched into one L2 only.
            # (Names must not collide with the loop variables of the dynamic
            # `if wave_id == 0` below.)
            rm_lin = fx.Int32(bid_x) + fx.Int32(bid_y) * gx
            rm_w = rm_lin // 8
            bid_x = rm_w % gx
            bid_y = (rm_lin % 8) * (gy // 8) + rm_w // gx
        lane_id = tid % 64
        wave_id = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(tid // 64))
        wave_id = fx.Int32(wave_id)
        kb = wave_id * T_per
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SharedStorage).peek()

        _scale_atom = fx.make_mma_atom(fx.rocdl.cdna4.MFMA_Scale(16, 16, 128, layout_elem))
        tiled_mma = fx.make_tiled_mma(
            _scale_atom,
            fx.make_layout((1, 1, 1), (0, 0, 0)),
            fx.make_tile(None, None, fx.make_layout((32, 4), (1, 32))),
        )

        gA = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_a, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * K)
        gB = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_b)
        gC = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_c, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * N * 2)

        tA = fx.flat_divide(gA, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_k))[None, None, bid_x, None]
        tB = fx.flat_divide(gB, fx.make_tile(tile_n, tile_k))[None, None, bid_y, None]
        tC = fx.flat_divide(gC, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_n))[None, None, bid_x, bid_y]

        buf_copy = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), layout_elem)
        thr_mma = tiled_mma.thr_slice(lane_id)
        thr_g2r_B = fx.make_tiled_copy_B(buf_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(lane_id)
        pB_g = thr_g2r_B.partition_S(tB)
        frag_B_layout = thr_mma.partition_B(tB).layout(None, None, None, 0)
        frag_Bs = [fx.make_fragment_like(frag_B_layout, layout_elem.ir_type) for _ in range(T_per)]
        if const_expr(a_lds):
            # A: row-coalesced global loads (8 rows x 128 B per instruction),
            # then a per-wave swizzled LDS hop into the MFMA A layout.
            uni_copy = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), layout_elem)
            k_blocks16 = tile_k // 16
            swz_bits = k_blocks16.bit_length() - 1
            swz = fx.SwizzleType.get(swz_bits, 4, swz_bits)
            a_tile_elems = tile_m * tile_k
            wave_base = wave_id * (T_per * a_tile_elems)
            sA_list = [
                fx.make_view(
                    fx.add_offset(lds.a_st.ptr, wave_base + j * a_tile_elems),
                    fx.make_composed_layout(
                        fx.static(swz), fx.make_ordered_layout((tile_m, tile_k), (1, 0))
                    ),
                )
                for j in range(T_per)
            ]
            thr_g2s = tiled_copy_g2s.get_slice(lane_id)
            thr_s2r = fx.make_tiled_copy_A(uni_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(lane_id)
            pA_g = thr_g2s.partition_S(tA)
            pA_s_list = [thr_g2s.partition_D(sv) for sv in sA_list]
            pA_s2r_list = [thr_s2r.partition_S(sv) for sv in sA_list]
            frag_cpA = [fx.make_fragment_like(pA_s_list[0][None, None, None]) for _ in range(T_per)]
            frag_As = [thr_mma.make_fragment_A(sA_list[0]) for _ in range(T_per)]
            frag_As_rt = [thr_s2r.retile(f) for f in frag_As]
        else:
            thr_g2r_A = fx.make_tiled_copy_A(buf_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(lane_id)
            pA_g = thr_g2r_A.partition_S(tA)
            frag_A_layout = thr_mma.partition_A(tA).layout(None, None, None, 0)
            frag_As = [fx.make_fragment_like(frag_A_layout, layout_elem.ir_type) for _ in range(T_per)]
            frag_As_rt = [thr_g2r_A.retile(f) for f in frag_As]
        frag_Bs_rt = [thr_g2r_B.retile(f) for f in frag_Bs]
        frag_P = thr_mma.make_fragment_C(tC)
        frag_C = thr_mma.make_fragment_C(tC)

        sa_t = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_scale_a, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=M * SK * 4)
        sb_t = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_scale_b)
        sa_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(sa_t))
        sb_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(sb_t))

        def ld_f32(rsrc, elem_off):
            v = rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(Float32.ir_type, rsrc, fx.Int32(elem_off * 4), fx.Int32(0))
            return fx.Float32(v)

        row_base = bid_x * tile_m + (lane_id // 16) * 4
        sb_base = ((bid_y * tile_n) // _BLK) * SK + kb
        sb_vals = [ld_f32(sb_rsrc, sb_base + j) for j in range_constexpr(T_per)]
        sa_vals = []  # [mi][ii][j]
        for mi in range_constexpr(m_repeat):
            rows = []
            for ii in range_constexpr(4):
                base = (row_base + mi * 16 + ii) * SK + kb
                rows.append([ld_f32(sa_rsrc, base + j) for j in range_constexpr(T_per)])
            sa_vals.append(rows)

        for j in range_constexpr(T_per):
            if const_expr(a_lds):
                fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, kb + j], frag_cpA[j])
            else:
                fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, kb + j], frag_As_rt[j])
            fx.copy(buf_copy, pB_g[None, None, None, kb + j], frag_Bs_rt[j])
        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        if const_expr(a_lds):
            for j in range_constexpr(T_per):
                fx.copy(uni_copy, frag_cpA[j], pA_s_list[j][None, None, None])
            for j in range_constexpr(T_per):
                fx.copy(uni_copy, pA_s2r_list[j][None, None, 0], frag_As_rt[j][None, None, 0])

        acc_zero = Vec.filled(acc_size, 0.0, Float32)
        acc = acc_zero
        for j in range_constexpr(T_per):
            frag_P.store(acc_zero)
            fx.gemm(tiled_mma, frag_P, frag_As[j][None, None, 0], frag_Bs[j][None, None, 0], frag_P)
            scales = []
            for p in range_constexpr(acc_size):
                mi = p // 4
                ii = p % 4
                scales.append(sa_vals[mi][ii][j] * sb_vals[j])
            sv = Vec.from_elements(scales, Float32)
            acc = acc + Vec(frag_P.load()) * sv

        my_off = (wave_id * 64 + lane_id) * acc_size
        fx.ptr_store(acc, fx.add_offset(lds.red.ptr, my_off))
        gpu.barrier()
        if wave_id == fx.Int32(0):
            tot = acc
            for w in range_constexpr(1, num_kw):
                v = fx.make_view(
                    fx.add_offset(lds.red.ptr, (w * 64 + lane_id) * acc_size),
                    fx.make_layout(acc_size, 1),
                ).load()
                tot = tot + Vec(v)
            frag_C.store(tot)
            buf_copy_out = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy16b(0), out_elem_cls)
            thr_r2g_C = fx.make_tiled_copy_C(buf_copy_out, tiled_mma).get_slice(lane_id)
            pC_g = thr_r2g_C.partition_S(tC)
            frag_C_out = fx.make_fragment_like(frag_C, out_elem_cls.ir_type)
            frag_C_out.store(Vec(frag_C.load()).to(out_elem_cls))
            fx.copy(buf_copy_out, thr_r2g_C.retile(frag_C_out), pC_g)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch_decode(
        arg_c: fx.Tensor,
        arg_ws: fx.Tensor,
        arg_sem: fx.Tensor,
        arg_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_b: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_b: fx.Tensor,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        kp_elems = 16
        n0 = N // 16
        k0 = K // 64
        s_nlane = kp_elems
        s_klane = 16 * s_nlane
        s_k0 = 4 * s_klane
        s_n0 = k0 * s_k0
        preshuffle_B = fx.Tensor(
            fx.make_view(
                fx.get_iter(arg_b),
                fx.make_layout(((16, n0), (kp_elems, 4, k0)), ((s_nlane, s_n0), (1, s_klane, s_k0))),
            )
        )
        arg_a_2d = fx.Tensor(fx.make_view(fx.get_iter(arg_a), fx.make_layout((M_pad, K), (K, 1))))
        arg_c_2d = fx.Tensor(fx.make_view(fx.get_iter(arg_c), fx.make_layout((M_pad, N), (N, 1))))
        thrs_k = tile_k // 16
        thrs_m = 64 // thrs_k
        tiled_copy_g2s = fx.make_tiled_copy(
            fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), layout_elem),
            fx.make_layout(((thrs_k, thrs_m), (1, 16)), ((thrs_m * 16, 1), (1, thrs_m))),

        kernel_decode(arg_c_2d, arg_a_2d, preshuffle_B, arg_scale_a, arg_scale_b, tiled_copy_g2s).launch(
            grid=(M_pad // tile_m, N // tile_n, 1),
            block=(total_threads, 1, 1),
            stream=stream,
        )

    return launch_decode


def _select_decode(m):
    """(tile_m, num_kw, a_lds) for the small-M path, or None for the split-K path.

    Measured (kernel us, graph replay): m<=2 direct A 2.67-2.71 vs 5.7 old;
    m 4..64 LDS A 2.86-3.44 vs 5.6-5.7; m=128 tile_m=32 4.87 vs 7.65;
    m=256 ties the old path (8.2) so it stays there.

    m=128 adds the XCD remap (4th element): on the 4x64 grid the default
    round-robin pins one m-block per XCD and spreads B over 4 XCDs' L2s; the
    remap gives each XCD 8 consecutive n16 columns x all 4 m-blocks.  Bit-exact
    vs no remap.  Harness-style single-launch replay with a fresh draw copied
    before each replay (us incl. launch, 3 interleaved rounds): no remap
    15.16-15.52, remap 14.60-14.80.  Routing m=128 to the GEMM path lost:
    32x64 sk2 kg2 remap (4,4) 15.86-15.96, sk4 kg1 16.20-16.24.  With the remap,
    tile_m=16 15.30-15.34 and num_kw=4 15.52-15.56 also lost.
    m=256 on this path (32, 8, LDS A) with the remap 18.93-19.70, without
    19.41-21.09, vs the GEMM path 17.01-18.28: stays on the GEMM path.
    """
    if m <= 2:
        return 16, 4, False
    if m <= 64:
        return 16, 8, True
    if m <= 128:
        return 32, 8, True, True
    return None
